newsitem.title: USA: Sherwood Group to buy Dresdner's NYSE unit.
newsitem.headline: Sherwood Group to buy Dresdner's NYSE unit.

text.p: The Sherwood Group Inc said Monday it had definitively agreed to buy from Dresdner Bank AG all the stock of Dresdner - New York, a specialist handling 54 securities on the New York Stock Exchange.

According to Sherwood's U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing for the quarter ended February 28, the payment for Dresdner - New York is $5.215 million plus $12.2 million for the company's equity.
The purchase, which had been informally agreed upon in December, will include four seats on the NYSE, Sherwood said.
Sherwood has a limited partnership interest in a NYSE specialist firm called Equitrade Partners and said the acquisition of Dresdner - New York is "an excellent fit."
It said it will transfer Dresdner - New York's non-cash assets and liabilities to Equitrade, which will trade the stocks contributed by Dresdner - New York.
The deal is subject to approval of the New York Stock Exchange and federal antitrust review, but Sherwood said it should be completed before May.
